Hi 👋 ,

I have a B/1 work visa and recently started working for an Israeli company in full time contract.

I understand that employers are required to provide private health insurance for foreign workers, but I’d like to hear from people who are in the same situation.

- Did your employer arrange your health insurance?
- Which insurance company do you have?
- How much, if anything, is deducted from your salary each month?
- Did your employer give you a copy of the policy?

Thanks!
